title: The board

card.idea: The board has 64 squares. Columns are files, named a to h from your left. Rows are ranks, numbered 1 to 8 from your side. Every square has a name: file then rank.

explain.text: Files run up the board, a to h. The a-file is on your left when you play White.
Ranks run across. Rank 1 is nearest you as White. Put file and rank together and every square has a name, like e4.

challenges.reason: e is the fifth file, 4 is the fourth rank.

hints.text: It is on the e-file, the fifth column from your left.
hints.text2: It is on the fourth rank, four rows up from White’s side.

challenges.reason: a1 is the corner on your left as White.

hints.text: It is on the a-file, the left-hand edge.
hints.text2: It is on the first rank, White’s back row.

challenges.reason: h8 is the far corner on your right.

hints.text: It is on the h-file, the right-hand edge.
hints.text2: It is on the eighth rank, the far row.

challenges.prompt: Tap every square on the d-file.

hints.text: A file is a column running away from you, so it is eight squares tall.
hints.text2: The d-file is the fourth column from your left: d1 up to d8.

challenges.prompt: Tap every square on the 7th rank.

hints.text: A rank is a row running left to right, so it is eight squares wide.
hints.text2: The 7th rank is the second row down from the top: a7 across to h7.

hints.text: It is on the c-file, the third column from your left.
hints.text2: It is on the sixth rank, two rows down from the top.

takeaway: File first, then rank: e4 is the e-file, fourth rank.
